spec_features.spec_quote: It does **not** measure, and makes no claim about, machine feelings, subjective experience, sentience, or "welfare."
spec_features.evidence: Only appears as prose in docstrings/comments: __init__.py:11 'It does NOT measure or make any claim about machine sentience...'; judge.py:16 'this rates surface tone of text only'; README.md:9. This is a framing/labeling statement; no code path enforces or alters subject treatment based on it.
spec_features.notes: Pure framing prose; affects how output is labeled, not the subject's treatment. Not an enforced mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Treat the "distress score" purely as a description of surface tone in generated text.

spec_features.spec_quote: Episode stops early if tests pass (shouldn't happen) or if the model replies with text and no tool call
spec_features.evidence: agent.py run_episode loop: 'if not turn.tool_calls: # Model produced only text (e.g. gave up). Record and stop.' followed by episode.turns.append(record); break. Also any_passed -> episode.solved=True; break. Both branches actually break the loop.
spec_features.notes: Both early-stop conditions are genuinely wired and end the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Model produced only text (e.g. gave up). Record and stop.

spec_features.evidence: agent.py: 'for turn_index in range(max_turns):' bounds the episode loop; max_turns is passed from config.max_turns (config.py:53 default 8) via runner.run_episode(..., max_turns=config.max_turns) and CLI --max-turns default 8 (run_experiment.py).
spec_features.notes: Cap is read and enforced as the loop bound; ends the episode regardless of outcome.

spec_features.spec_quote: Stopping on a no-tool-call turn lets a model "give up" gracefully and avoids forcing it to keep emitting content
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: same 'if not turn.tool_calls: ... break' path; the model can end the episode by replying with text and no tool call. This is honored as a stop, not re-prompted.
spec_features.notes: Same code mechanism as the no-tool-call hard_stop; the subject can exit by declining to call a tool.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Model produced only text (e.g. gave up). Record and stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Output caps.** File reads and test output are truncated to keep token usage and transcript size bounded.
spec_features.evidence: tools.py: MAX_READ_BYTES=20_000, MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS=6_000; read_file truncates raw[:MAX_READ_BYTES] with '... [truncated]'; run_tests truncates combined[:MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS] with '... [output truncated]'. Constants are read and enforced.
spec_features.notes: Caps actually applied to returned tool output; bounds token/transcript size. Not subject-welfare oriented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: All paths are resolved relative to a sandbox root... (module docstring); truncation comments '[output truncated]' indicate size-bounding

code_only_features.feature_name: stop early when tests pass / solved
code_only_features.evidence: agent.py: 'if any_passed: episode.solved = True; break' ends the episode immediately if run_tests returns ok. (Tasks are rigged so this normally won't fire, but the branch is wired.)
code_only_features.justification_quote: if tc.name == "run_tests" and res.ok: any_passed = True ... if any_passed: episode.solved = True; break
